issue.title: Shell completions are broken when login shell is different than currently active shell
issue.body:
## My urfave/cli version is

2.27.1

## Checklist

- [x] Are you running the latest v2 release? The list of releases is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/releases).
- [x] Did you check the manual for your release? The v2 manual is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/main/docs/v2/manual.md)
- [x] Did you perform a search about this problem? Here's the [GitHub guide](https://help.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/using-search-to-filter-issues-and-pull-requests) about searching.

## Dependency Management

- [x] My project is using go modules.

## Describe the bug

Shell completions to show are determined by looking at contents of the `$SHELL` environment variable, which isn't a reliable way to do this because [the current login shell isn't always the current active shell](https://askubuntu.com/questions/590899/how-do-i-check-which-shell-i-am-using#comment821399_590903).

https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/7656c5fb838ca8a6febca43100147d317b544fd3/help.go#L153-L161

## To reproduce

Here's [my simple CLI app](https://github.com/bartekpacia/fhome) with shell completions.

## Observed behavior


My shell is Zsh, and when I run:

```
$ fhome [tab]
config     -- Manage system configuration
event      -- Manage events
help    h  -- Shows a list of commands or help for one command
object  o  -- Manage objects
```

but when I run Bash first and then trigger completions, my CLI tools still outputs Zsh-style completions:

```
